name: Firefox
description: A friendly, private web browser for websites, email on the web, video calls and online shopping.

name: Zen Browser
description: A Firefox-based browser with vertical tabs and workspaces that keeps pages tidy and distraction free.

name: Chromium
description: A fast browser that works with almost every website, built on the same engine as Google Chrome.

name: Brave
description: A browser that blocks ads and trackers automatically, so pages load faster and you are followed around the web less.

name: LibreWolf
description: A hardened version of Firefox with the strongest privacy settings already switched on.

name: Vivaldi
description: A feature-packed browser with built-in notes, tab stacking and many ways to arrange things your way.

name: Thunderbird
description: Read and write email from all your accounts (Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and more) in one place.

name: Zoom
description: Join video meetings and calls with family and friends. Great for seeing the grandchildren.

name: Signal
description: Send private text messages, photos and make voice or video calls with your contacts.

name: Telegram
description: Chat with friends and family and share photos and videos in groups.

name: Family Help (RustDesk)
description: Lets a trusted family member see your screen and help you from their own computer when something goes wrong.

name: LibreOffice
description: Write letters, make spreadsheets and presentations. Opens Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.

name: VLC
description: Plays almost any video, DVD or music file you throw at it.

name: Spotify
description: Listen to millions of songs, radio and podcasts. A free account works.

name: GIMP
description: A powerful photo editor for touching up pictures, cropping and removing red-eye.

name: OBS Studio
description: Record your screen or camera, or broadcast live.

name: Steam
description: A store and library for PC games. Newer games need a fairly powerful computer.

name: Visual Studio Code
description: A popular editor for writing computer programs.

name: Waydroid
description: Runs a full Android system in a window so you can use Android apps. Needs a modern computer; not recommended on older Macs.

name: VirtualBox
description: Create virtual computers so you can try Windows or other systems in a window on your desktop.

name: VMware Workstation
description: Virtual machine software. Its installer is a .bundle file that Bundle Runner can open.
